name: kara_walk2
prompt: Turn to a side profile facing right and walk to the right in a seamless 8-frame loop. Big wide strides: front leg reaches far forward with the heel touching the ground while the back leg pushes off behind, knees clearly bend, legs fully pass each other at mid-stride. Body rises on the passing frames and dips on the contact frames, slight side-to-side sway. Cape and ponytail trail behind with delay. Axe held across the body, swinging a little with each step. Same scale and ground line in every frame.
